shape_hint: A Woodruff key is a flat disc segment (a circular disc of diameter d2 with a portion cut off by a chord); in side view it looks like a larger-than-half circle of height h, and in the plan view it is a thin rectangle of width b. Overall thickness (b) is uniform; the rounded part sits in the shaft keyseat, the flat top projects into the hub keyway.

role_map.h: key height (from flat to the bottom of the round)
role_map.d2: diameter of the disc the key is cut from
